dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Oh! You're at the door and you still can't tell who I am?

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: I'm the owner of this inn, which means that this inn is owned by me.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Ah, look, Sisi. Young people's attention span is terrible these days.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Sisi? Sisi! Where did that furball run off to now?
